channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Collision on R610 Douglas Road
item.description: Reports of a collision on the R610 Douglas Road, near the junction with Well Road. Take care on approach.

item.title: Irish Workers Fear "Catastrophic" Cyber Attack as Scams Surge Across Ireland
item.description: Over half of Irish workers fear a major cyber attack in 2026 as AI-driven threats and workplace scams surge nationwide.

item.title: Cork to Light Up for Charity Night Run This Wednesday
item.description: Run The Night Cork takes place this Wednesday at 8pm from Marina Market, a five-mile charity run open to all in aid of Little Blue Heroes.

item.title: ⛴️ Cross River Ferry Suspended
item.description: The Cross River Ferry has been suspended due to fog. Service will resume when possible.May run intermittently as visibility allows.Source: In Cobh - Cross River Ferry Monitor | 8 February 2026, 09:19

item.title: Surface Water Reported on N25 Waterford Road
item.description: Surface water has been reported, westbound, on the N25 Waterford Road at multiple locations including Junction 1 (Dunkettle), and Junction 2 (Little Island). Take care on approach.Source: TII Variable Message Signs.

item.title: Surface Water Reported on N40 South Ring Road
item.description: Surface water has been reported, eastbound and westbound, on the N40 South Ring Road at multiple locations including Junction 6 (Kinsale Road), and Junction 10 (Mahon), and the Jack Lynch Tunnel. Take care on approach.Source: TII Variable Message Signs.

item.title: Collision at Carhoon West Bandon
item.description: Reports of a collision at Carhoon West, Bandon. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: How AI is Fuelling a New Wave of Online Fraud Ahead of Valentine's Day
item.description: AI-powered romance scams are surging ahead of Valentine's Day. Over €2.8m stolen from 88 victims in Ireland in 2025. Know the warning signs.

item.title: Collision in Inchigeelagh
item.description: Reports of a collision on the R584 Inchigeelagh, just west of the village. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision on N28 Shannonpark R/A
item.description: Reports of a collision on the N28 at Shannonpark Roundabout. Take care on approach.
